This is a lesson on one drum groove the [Backing Track](../../tools/backing-track.qmd) band plays: **Cha-cha**. It is built up from a simpler pattern, one step at a time, and every step is played by the band and written out as it plays. How the examples work: press ▶ Play, switch players in and out with the buttons beside it, and read what the band will play on the staff underneath: the whole pass is written out when Play starts, before it sounds. The tempo slider at the bottom of the page slows everything down.

[All the accompaniment patterns](index.qmd) · [Drum grooves](index.qmd#drums)

## The pattern

The cymbal on every beat like the cha-cha bell, cross-stick on 2, and two tom notes on 4 and the and of 4.

It belongs in *Cha-cha*. Here it is in the cha-cha style with the whole band. Switch the other players off to hear it alone.

## Step 1: Hi-hat: quarter notes

Start with something simpler. Closed hi-hat on every beat, kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4. The first rock beat. In 3/4: hi-hat on every beat, kick on 1, snare on 3.

This is a pattern of its own: [the lesson on it](drums-hhquarters.qmd) takes it further. Here it is only a step on the way, slowly. The drums play alone first; switch the bass and chords on when it is steady.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="chacha" data-chart="Am|Dm|E7|Am" data-tempo="78" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Step:" data-choices='[{"label":"Hi-hat: quarter notes","opts":{"groove":"hhquarters"}}]'></div>

## Step 2: Cha-cha, slowly

Now the pattern itself. Compare it with the step before: press each button while the band plays and watch what changes on the staff.

**How to play it.** The cymbal on every beat like the cha-cha bell, cross-stick on 2, two tom notes on 4 and the and of 4: the cha-cha-cha.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="chacha" data-chart="Am|Dm|E7|Am" data-tempo="78" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Compare:" data-choices='[{"label":"Cha-cha","opts":{"groove":"chacha"}},{"label":"Hi-hat: quarter notes (the step before)","opts":{"groove":"hhquarters"}}]'></div>

## Step 3: Up to tempo, with the band

The whole band, at 112 beats a minute. Play along, then switch the band's drum kit off and take the part yourself.
